boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Rowan University
boards.description: Ten public, under-21-safe food and convenience destinations in Glassboro with currently published late operating hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 1101 N. Delsea Drive, Glassboro
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when a late food pickup fits your plans; the location publishes daily service through 3:00 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Glassboro drive-thru with hours extending to 3:00 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its Glassboro drive-thru hours as 9:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1101 N. Delsea Drive, Glassboro
cards.access_notes: Published drive-thru hours are 9:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. daily; dine-in hours end at midnight.

cards.title: Wendy's
cards.subtitle: 685 N. Delsea Drive, Glassboro
cards.notes: Check the restaurant or drive-thru after evening commitments; the official location page lists service until 2:00 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: Restaurant and drive-thru service listed until 2:00 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists both restaurant and drive-thru hours at 685 N. Delsea Drive as 8:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed restaurant and drive-thru hours run until 2:00 a.m. every day; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: 7-Eleven on Rowan Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 324 Rowan Blvd, Glassboro
cards.notes: For a late convenience-store stop, head to this Rowan Boulevard location; its official page identifies it as open around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 convenience-store option directly on Rowan Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven's location page says the store at 324 Rowan Blvd is open 24/7 and offers hot foods.
cards.access_notes: Official location page states “Open 24/7” and lists hot foods among store features.

cards.title: Domino's on Rowan Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 231 Rowan Blvd, Glassboro
cards.notes: Use the location’s online ordering page to confirm the day’s closing time before placing a carryout or delivery order late in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A Rowan Boulevard pizza location whose official page lists service until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Glassboro location page lists 231 Rowan Blvd and shows it open until 12:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently shows “Today Until 12:00 AM”; confirm the displayed daily hours before ordering.

cards.title: El Mariachi Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 512 Delsea Drive North, Glassboro
cards.notes: Plan a late dinner or takeout stop at this Delsea Drive restaurant; its ordering page publishes midnight closing times throughout the week.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant with posted service until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: El Mariachi's ordering page lists service until 12:00 a.m. Sunday through Saturday at 512 Delsea Drive North.
cards.source_title: El Mariachi Mexican Restaurant — online ordering
cards.access_notes: The restaurant's official Toast ordering page lists closing at 12:00 a.m. every day.

cards.title: Baskin-Robbins
cards.subtitle: 55 Delsea Drive, Glassboro
cards.notes: For a later dessert pickup, consult the Glassboro location page; it currently lists this Delsea Drive shop closing at midnight.
cards.short_summary: An ice-cream stop with a published midnight closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Baskin-Robbins' Glassboro location listing says the shop at 55 Delsea Drive closes at 12:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official location directory currently identifies 55 Delsea Drive as closing at 12:00 a.m.; verify on the day of a visit.

cards.title: McDonald's on Delsea Drive
cards.subtitle: 656 Delsea Drive, Glassboro
cards.notes: Use this Delsea Drive location when you need a very late pickup; the official restaurant locator page identifies it as a 24-hour location.
cards.short_summary: A Glassboro McDonald's with 24-hour availability listed by the restaurant locator.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official locator page for 656 Delsea Drive identifies the Glassboro restaurant as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Official location listing identifies this as open 24 hours; confirm lobby and drive-thru service details before leaving.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A Glassboro
cards.subtitle: 525 Delsea Drive North, Glassboro
cards.notes: Make this an early-evening food stop rather than a midnight one; the official page lists weekday dine-in, carry-out, and drive-thru until 10:00 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A weekday option with official service hours through 10:00 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A lists Monday–Friday dine-in, carry-out, and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–10:00 p.m. for its Glassboro location.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists weekday service until 10:00 p.m., Saturday until 8:00 p.m., and Sunday closed.

cards.title: Gino's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 844 N. Delsea Drive, Glassboro
cards.notes: For a Friday or Saturday pizza pickup, use the posted weekend schedule and place an order before the 11:00 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A local pizzeria with Friday and Saturday hours through 11:00 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Gino's Pizzeria lists Friday and Saturday hours of 10:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. at 844 N. Delsea Drive.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday hours until 11:00 p.m.; Monday–Thursday and Sunday close at 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Monarch Diner
cards.subtitle: 500 Delsea Drive, Glassboro
cards.notes: Choose a Friday or Saturday dinner window here when you want table service; the diner’s own site posts a 10:00 p.m. weekend close.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned diner with Friday and Saturday hours through 10:00 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Monarch Diner lists hours of 7:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. on Friday and Saturday at 500 Delsea Drive.
cards.access_notes: Official site states Friday and Saturday hours until 10:00 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday hours end at 9:00 p.m.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Rowan destinations for games, events, recreation, art, astronomy, and campus history.

cards.title: Play a round in the Game Room
cards.subtitle: Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Bring your Rowan ID and choose from video, board, or arcade-style games when you want a low-key break with other students.
cards.short_summary: A student-ID game space inside the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan says the Game Room offers current Rowan students free video, board, and arcade-style games with a Rowan ID.
cards.access_notes: For Rowan students; bring a Rowan ID.

cards.title: Join a Profs Place trivia night
cards.subtitle: Ground floor, Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Check the campus-activities calendar, then arrive with a team or compete solo during the Wednesday-night trivia program.
cards.short_summary: A named Student Center venue used for recurring trivia.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan lists Profs Place as the ground-floor location for Wednesday-night themed or general trivia.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current event schedule with Chamberlain Student Center & Campus Activities.

cards.title: Use the Student Center Pit as an event bulletin stop
cards.subtitle: Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Pause by the interior poster walls to spot Student University Programmers announcements before deciding what to add to your week.
cards.short_summary: A named Student Center interior area used for campus-event posters.
cards.evidence_claim: Student University Programmers directs students to the Student Center Pit for its giant event posters along the interior walls.
cards.access_notes: Event listings change; verify details through the current campus calendar.

cards.title: Look for a campus workshop in Eynon Ballroom
cards.subtitle: Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Watch for Student Success Summit and similar listings, then use the ballroom as a starting point for meeting campus partners.
cards.short_summary: A named ballroom that hosts student-focused programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan scheduled its Student Success Summit in the Chamberlain Student Center's Eynon Ballroom, with workshops, a student panel, and campus connections.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on the scheduled event; consult its RSVP or event information.

cards.title: Plan a research stop at Campbell Library
cards.subtitle: Main campus library
cards.notes: Use the library's research support and, when available, reserve a group study room through the Rowan Libraries reservation system.
cards.short_summary: Rowan's main library and a hub for research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan's student-success resources state that Campbell Library group study rooms can be reserved online and librarians provide research assistance.
cards.access_notes: Campbell renovation affects spaces; its library page reports bookable spaces offline during Phase 2.

cards.title: See the current exhibition at the Art Gallery & Museum
cards.subtitle: 301 High Street, Glassboro
cards.notes: Check the exhibition calendar, then build in time to view contemporary work and any associated public programming at this High Street venue.
cards.short_summary: A campus cultural venue presenting rotating contemporary-art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan states that all Art Gallery & Museum exhibits are free and open to the public at 301 High Street in Glassboro.
cards.source_title: Reclaiming Narratives: Rowan’s Art Gallery & Museum Announces 2025-2026 Exhibitions
cards.access_notes: Check the current exhibition schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Read the Summit story at Hollybush
cards.subtitle: Historic Rowan campus mansion
cards.notes: Visit during an official event or meeting opportunity and look for the displays connecting the mansion to the 1967 Glassboro Summit.
cards.short_summary: A preserved Victorian mansion with Rowan and Cold War history.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan says Hollybush displays artifacts from the 1967 Summit and is used for official University and community receptions and meetings.
cards.access_notes: Hollybush is an official event and meeting venue; do not assume unrestricted interior access.

cards.title: Take an Arboretum walk between classes
cards.subtitle: Rowan University campus
cards.notes: Use the campus landscape as an outdoor reset and notice the plant collections that support Rowan's environmental learning and stewardship work.
cards.short_summary: A campus landscape framed by Rowan as a living classroom.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan describes the University Arboretum as a living classroom connecting people, plants, and place for curiosity, research, and environmental stewardship.
cards.access_notes: Use established campus paths and follow posted grounds guidance.

cards.title: Schedule an active break at the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: 300 North Campus Drive
cards.notes: Bring your Rowan ID and choose a facility or program that fits your plan, from the pool and track to intramurals or group fitness.
cards.short_summary: A large campus recreation facility with indoor activity spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan says its Rec Center includes a gymnasium, indoor track, pool, racquetball courts, fitness areas, and programming such as intramurals and group fitness.
cards.access_notes: Located at 300 North Campus Drive; full-time students have access through the student activities fee, subject to Recreation policies.

cards.title: Check for a planetarium show or observatory open house
cards.subtitle: Rowan University, Glassboro
cards.notes: Review the current program listing, then choose a public show or telescope open-house date that fits your schedule and ticket needs.
cards.short_summary: A Rowan astronomy venue for immersive shows and telescope viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan says the Edelman Planetarium offers public shows and observatory open houses with telescope viewing.
cards.access_notes: Public programs are open to attendees; verify the current schedule and ticket requirements before going.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Free Rowan and Glassboro options with explicit no-cost access or a current Rowan student admission policy.

cards.title: View an exhibition at 301 High Street
cards.subtitle: 301 High Street West, Glassboro
cards.notes: Walk through the current exhibition together, then use the gallery guide or exhibition text to compare what each person noticed.
cards.short_summary: A downtown-campus contemporary-art gallery with free public admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan states that admission to exhibitions and museum events is free and open to the public, and lists RUMOCA at 301 High Street.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information | Rowan University Museum of Contemporary Art
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; use Rowan's posted gallery hours and closure notices before visiting.

cards.title: See RUMOCA at Westby Hall
cards.subtitle: Westby Hall, first floor, Rowan University
cards.notes: Plan around an announced exhibition or appointment, then take time to look closely at a few works instead of rushing the room.
cards.short_summary: A second Rowan contemporary-art location on the Glassboro campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan lists RUMOCA at Westby Hall and states that admission to exhibitions and museum events is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information | Rowan University Museum of Contemporary Art
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; the Westby Hall location may require an appointment during summer break.

cards.entity_name: Rowan student performance at Pfleeger Concert Hall
cards.title: Reserve a Pfleeger performance
cards.subtitle: Pfleeger Concert Hall, Wilson Hall
cards.notes: Choose an arts performance from the season calendar and reserve student tickets ahead of time so your group can sit together.
cards.short_summary: A free Rowan-student ticket option for performances in Pfleeger Concert Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan's Performing Arts Box Office says current Rowan students receive free admission to all College of the Arts performances and identifies Pfleeger Concert Hall as a venue.
cards.access_notes: Current Rowan students only; reserve in advance when possible and present a valid Rowan ID at the venue.

cards.entity_name: Rowan student performance at Boyd Recital Hall
cards.title: Reserve a Boyd recital
cards.subtitle: Boyd Recital Hall, Wilson Hall
cards.notes: Check the season calendar for a recital, reserve student tickets, and meet outside Wilson Hall before the performance begins.
cards.short_summary: A free Rowan-student ticket option for performances in Boyd Recital Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan's Performing Arts Box Office says current Rowan students receive free admission to all College of the Arts performances and identifies Boyd Recital Hall as a venue.
cards.access_notes: Current Rowan students only; reserve in advance when possible and present a valid Rowan ID at the venue.

cards.entity_name: Rowan student performance at Tohill Theater
cards.title: Plan a Tohill Theater show
cards.subtitle: Tohill Theater, Bunce Hall
cards.notes: Pick a listed theater or dance date, reserve student tickets, and arrive with enough time to find the Bunce Hall entrance.
cards.short_summary: A free Rowan-student ticket option for performances in Tohill Theater.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan's Performing Arts Box Office says current Rowan students receive free admission to all College of the Arts performances and identifies Tohill Theater as a venue.
cards.access_notes: Current Rowan students only; reserve in advance when possible and present a valid Rowan ID at the venue.

cards.title: Catch a Studio 159 performance
cards.subtitle: Studio 159, Bunce Hall
cards.notes: Look for a Studio 159 event on the season calendar, reserve student tickets, and use the smaller venue for a focused arts night.
cards.short_summary: A free Rowan-student ticket option for performances in Studio 159.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan's Performing Arts Box Office says current Rowan students receive free admission to all College of the Arts performances and identifies Studio 159 as a venue.
cards.access_notes: Current Rowan students only; reserve in advance when possible and present a valid Rowan ID at the venue.

cards.title: Attend a Presidential Lecture
cards.subtitle: Rowan University, Glassboro campus
cards.notes: Watch Rowan's event listings for a scheduled speaker, then bring a friend and stay afterward to compare notes from the talk.
cards.short_summary: A public speaker series that Rowan describes as free and open to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan University states that its Presidential Lecture Series is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: What We Do | Rowan University Events
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public when scheduled; confirm the specific event's date, location, and any registration requirement.

cards.entity_name: Free Internet access at Glassboro Branch
cards.title: Use the library's free internet
cards.subtitle: Glassboro Branch, 101 Rowan Boulevard
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or use a library computer, then pair a work session with a quiet reading or browsing break nearby.
cards.short_summary: A no-purchase library stop with free internet access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gloucester County Library System lists free Internet access among services at its Glassboro Branch.
cards.source_title: Glassboro Branch | Gloucester County Library System
cards.access_notes: Free Internet access is listed by the branch; visit during posted branch hours and follow library computer-use policies.

cards.title: Browse the Glassboro Branch stacks
cards.subtitle: Glassboro Branch, 101 Rowan Boulevard
cards.notes: Choose a shelf to browse together, pull a few titles, and use the reading areas for a calm, screen-free conversation.
cards.short_summary: A library browsing hang supported by the branch's fine-free book lending policy.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gloucester County Library System lists books at the Glassboro Branch as fine free and provides the branch's address and hours.
cards.source_title: Glassboro Branch | Gloucester County Library System
cards.access_notes: Browsing requires no purchase; borrowing eligibility and card requirements are governed by Gloucester County Library System policies.

cards.title: Join the Rowan BioBlitz
cards.subtitle: Glassboro campus, meeting at Discovery Hall's TimeSweeps sculpture
cards.notes: When Rowan schedules the BioBlitz, bring a phone with iNaturalist and team up to document plants or animals around campus.
cards.short_summary: A Rowan citizen-science activity that the university has offered free and open to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan describes its BioBlitz as a free, open-to-the-public campus activity for documenting local biodiversity.
cards.access_notes: This was a scheduled event; confirm that a new BioBlitz date is posted before making plans.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Rowan study environments, including technology-equipped, reservable, informal, and residence-hall options.

cards.title: Tech Lounge
cards.subtitle: Top floor, Robinson Hall
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or use the available PCs and extra monitors; the lounge also provides Raspberry Pis for hands-on computing work.
cards.short_summary: A computer science lounge with PCs, monitors, and maker-oriented equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan identifies the Tech Lounge on Robinson Hall’s top floor as a free student study and work space with PCs, extra monitors, and Raspberry Pis.
cards.access_notes: Official page describes it as a free space for students; equipment availability may vary.

cards.title: The Pit
cards.subtitle: Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Use the central lounge between scheduled events; during academic semesters it is designated as a lounge and study space.
cards.short_summary: An informal student-center lounge that supports studying during the semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan states that the Pit serves as a central lounge and, during academic semesters, a lounge/study space.
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Center’s event schedule; sound restrictions and events may affect the space.

cards.title: Student Center Room 128
cards.subtitle: Chamberlain Student Center express-scheduling room
cards.notes: Check the reservation display, then request immediate use through 25Live when the room is open; plan for a two-hour maximum.
cards.short_summary: A bookable Student Center room available for short-notice quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s Student Center policy lists Room 128 as an express-scheduling room for quiet-study and last-minute meeting requests.
cards.source_title: Chamberlain Student Center Policies & Procedures Manual
cards.access_notes: Rowan students must confirm it is open and request it in 25Live; use ends after two hours or at the next reservation.

cards.title: Student Center Room 160
cards.subtitle: Chamberlain Student Center express-scheduling room
cards.notes: Look at the reservation display outside the room and use 25Live’s Express Scheduling feature if there is an open window.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center room designated for on-demand quiet study when unreserved.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s Student Center policy lists Room 160 as an express-scheduling room to accommodate quiet-study requests.
cards.source_title: Chamberlain Student Center Policies & Procedures Manual
cards.access_notes: Available only around scheduled reservations; a student may use it for up to two hours or until the next booking.

cards.title: Student Center Room 161
cards.subtitle: Chamberlain Student Center express-scheduling room
cards.notes: Use the posted reservation display before requesting the room in 25Live, and leave time to clear out before the next booking.
cards.short_summary: An on-demand Student Center room for a quiet, short study session.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s Student Center policy lists Room 161 among rooms opened around reservations for quiet-study and immediate-use requests.
cards.source_title: Chamberlain Student Center Policies & Procedures Manual
cards.access_notes: Students must request immediate use through 25Live when open; use is limited to two hours or the next reservation.

cards.title: Chamberlain Student Center Expansion
cards.subtitle: Connected to the Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Set up at an open table in the addition and keep plans flexible around programs, gatherings, and Student Center traffic.
cards.short_summary: A newer Student Center addition with tables and study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s 2025 opening report says the Student Center expansion includes study rooms and tables for studying.
cards.source_title: GRAND opening! Campus celebrates $31.4M Student Center expansion
cards.access_notes: Part of the Student Center; availability can be affected by events and building operations.

cards.title: Whitney Center Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Floors 2–5, Whitney Center
cards.notes: Residents can use furnished floor study rooms with dry-erase boards; bring materials and use their Rowan ID for building entry.
cards.short_summary: Furnished residence-hall study rooms with dry-erase boards.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan lists furnished study rooms with dry-erase boards on floors 2 through 5 of Whitney Center.
cards.access_notes: Whitney Center residents use Rowan ID swipe access for the building; study rooms are on floors 2–5.

cards.title: Evergreen Hall Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Ends of hallways, Evergreen Hall
cards.notes: Evergreen residents can use the study rooms at hallway ends for focused work; return the space ready for other residents.
cards.short_summary: Residence-hall study rooms distributed along Evergreen’s hallways.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan lists study rooms at the end of each hallway in Evergreen Hall.
cards.access_notes: Located in a residence hall; access is intended for Evergreen Hall residents.

cards.entity_name: Holly Pointe Commons Pod Study Spaces
cards.title: Holly Pointe Commons Pod Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Holly Pointe Commons residential pods
cards.notes: Use the pod study areas for nearby coursework, and keep shared lounge-and-study settings workable for fellow pod residents.
cards.short_summary: Study areas integrated into Holly Pointe Commons residential pods.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan states that each Holly Pointe Commons pod includes student bedrooms, lounge and study spaces, bathrooms, and laundry rooms.
cards.access_notes: Holly Pointe Commons uses card access for building and bedroom entry; pod spaces serve residents.

cards.title: Rowan Boulevard Apartments Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Rowan Boulevard Apartments
cards.notes: Use the apartment complex’s shared study rooms for focused work, and rely on Rowan ID access to enter the residential building.
cards.short_summary: Shared study rooms within Rowan Boulevard Apartments.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s housing page states that study rooms in Rowan Boulevard Apartments receive daily housekeeping service.
cards.access_notes: Residential access is controlled by Rowan ID; the official housing page identifies shared study rooms in the complex.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each

cards.title: Barnes & Noble Collegiate Superstore
cards.subtitle: Rowan Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Browse the University book section and general shelves, then use the indoor/outdoor Starbucks café as a pause point on Rowan Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A bookstore-and-café stop on the boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan identifies the Barnes & Noble Collegiate Superstore on Rowan Boulevard and describes its University book section, Varsity Spirit Shop, and Starbucks café.
cards.access_notes: Retail and café purchases are optional; verify current store access before visiting.

cards.title: Rowan University Welcome Center
cards.subtitle: Rowan Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Start with the official visitor point at 131 Rowan Boulevard when planning a campus walk or looking for tour information.
cards.short_summary: The official starting point for Rowan campus tours.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan says its 1.5-hour, two-mile walking tours start at the Welcome Center at 131 Rowan Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: Tour availability and visitor services vary; check Rowan’s visit page before going.

cards.title: Glassboro Town Square
cards.subtitle: Rowan Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the open square as a waypoint between campus and downtown, and check the borough or University calendar for scheduled public events.
cards.short_summary: A 1.5-acre downtown gathering space beside the boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan reports that Glassboro’s 1.5-acre Town Square opened for community events, celebrations, concerts, festivals, and shows.
cards.access_notes: The square is an outdoor public space; event attendance or activities may have separate requirements.

cards.entity_name: Courtyard by Marriott Glassboro Rowan University
cards.title: Courtyard by Marriott Glassboro Rowan University
cards.subtitle: Rowan Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use this named hotel landmark at 325 Rowan Boulevard to orient yourself one block east of the main campus.
cards.short_summary: A hotel-and-conference landmark near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan identifies the Courtyard by Marriott Hotel and Conference Center at 325 Rowan Boulevard, one block east of the main campus.
cards.access_notes: Hotel facilities and lodging require arranging access or purchase with the hotel.

cards.title: Enterprise Center
cards.subtitle: Rowan Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Spot the Enterprise Center at 225 Rowan Boulevard as a useful corridor landmark with classrooms, offices, retail space, and parking.
cards.short_summary: A mixed academic, retail, and parking landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan says the Enterprise Center at 225 Rowan Boulevard includes retail space, academic facilities, and a 1,194-space parking garage.
cards.access_notes: Academic and office areas may have limited public access; parking is subject to posted rules and fees.

cards.title: Cookie Munchers
cards.subtitle: Rowan Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Find the cookie shop at 217 Rowan Boulevard when you want a compact food stop while walking between the campus edge and downtown.
cards.short_summary: A dessert stop at 217 Rowan Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s local dining guide lists Cookie Munchers at 217 Rowan Boulevard in Glassboro.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required; confirm current hours and menu directly with the business.

cards.title: Kung Fu Tea
cards.subtitle: Rowan Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the shop at 224 Rowan Boulevard as a clearly addressed drink-stop option along the downtown side of the Rowan corridor.
cards.short_summary: A beverage shop at 224 Rowan Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s local dining guide lists Kung Fu Tea at 224 Rowan Boulevard in Glassboro.
cards.access_notes: Beverages require purchase; confirm current hours and offerings directly with the business.

cards.title: Yogo Factory Frozen Yogurt
cards.subtitle: Rowan Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Add the frozen-yogurt shop at 300 Rowan Boulevard to a short downtown walk when you want a dessert-oriented destination.
cards.short_summary: A frozen-yogurt stop at 300 Rowan Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s local dining guide lists Yogo Factory Frozen Yogurt at 300 Rowan Boulevard in Glassboro.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required; confirm current hours and offerings directly with the business.

cards.title: Playa Bowls Glassboro

cards.notes: Locate the bowl and smoothie shop at 328 Rowan Boulevard when mapping the eastern end of the corridor near the hotel.
cards.short_summary: A bowl-and-smoothie destination at 328 Rowan Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s local dining guide lists Playa Bowls at 328 Rowan Boulevard in Glassboro.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required; confirm current hours and offerings directly with the business.

cards.title: Aloha Poke Glassboro
cards.subtitle: High Street East corridor
cards.notes: Use the listed address at 26 High Street East as a specific food-stop marker just off the Rowan Boulevard downtown connection.
cards.short_summary: A food destination on High Street East.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s local dining guide lists Aloha Poke Glassboro at 26 High Street East in Glassboro.
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required; confirm current hours and offerings directly with the business.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Rowan traditions, from Homecoming competitions to long-running community and finals-week events.

cards.title: Hollybash
cards.subtitle: Spring outdoor festival at Rowan University
cards.notes: Plan for the April student-and-employee festival: check the current program for rides, games, food trucks and the featured concert.
cards.short_summary: Rowan’s spring festival has used the Hollybash name since 2016.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan documents Hollybash as a spring event that debuted in 2016, with food trucks, carnival rides, outdoor games and a major-artist concert.
cards.source_title: Can’t stop, won’t stop: Favorite student traditions still fuel Rowan pride
cards.access_notes: The cited University history says Hollybash is open to students and employees; verify the current event listing before attending.

cards.title: Holiday Helper
cards.subtitle: Student University Programmers charitable auction
cards.notes: Follow Student University Programmers announcements to view the virtual auction and support the selected charitable beneficiaries.
cards.short_summary: A long-running student fundraising tradition formerly called Project Santa.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan says Holiday Helper began more than 50 years ago as Project Santa and is one of the University’s longest-standing fundraising traditions.
cards.source_title: Can’t stop, won’t stop: Favorite student traditions still fuel Rowan pride
cards.access_notes: The University reports the auction has been held virtually in recent years; consult the current Student University Programmers notice.

cards.title: Rowan Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Annual week of Prof Pride in Glassboro
cards.notes: Use the official Homecoming schedule to pick a student competition, reunion program or game-day activity that fits your visit.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide reunion and student-competition tradition with roots before the 1950s.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan identifies annual Alumni Homecoming Day as a tradition dating to at least the 1940s and describes its postwar revival with football games.
cards.source_title: Can’t stop, won’t stop: Favorite student traditions still fuel Rowan pride
cards.access_notes: Current dates, registration and individual events are published on Rowan’s official Homecoming site.

cards.entity_name: Torch Run from Trenton to Glassboro
cards.title: The Torch Run
cards.subtitle: Homecoming relay carrying the Torch of Knowledge
cards.notes: Treat this as a historic Homecoming tradition: look for official Centennial or Homecoming announcements before expecting a current run.
cards.short_summary: A student-organized relay that has periodically reappeared in Rowan celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan documents a Torch Run from Trenton to Glassboro dating to at least 1958 and says the student-organized event has reemerged.
cards.source_title: Can’t stop, won’t stop: Favorite student traditions still fuel Rowan pride
cards.access_notes: Historical and revival activity is documented; the source does not establish that the relay occurs every year.

cards.title: Push Cart Competition
cards.subtitle: Rowan Homecoming student competition
cards.notes: Join or support a registered team through the official Homecoming schedule; use the event page for the year’s rules and timing.
cards.short_summary: A named competition placed on Rowan’s annual Homecoming Tuesday.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s official Homecoming schedule identifies the Push Cart Competition as part of the annual Homecoming week.
cards.source_title: Rowan University Homecoming Schedule of Events
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Tuesday in the official Homecoming overview; consult the current year’s detailed program for participation requirements.

cards.title: Homecoming Battleship
cards.subtitle: Rowan Homecoming student competition
cards.notes: Check the Homecoming Wednesday listing for team details and spectator information before heading to the competition.
cards.short_summary: An annual-favorite competition in Rowan’s Homecoming program.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s official Homecoming schedule calls Battleship an annual favorite and lists it among Wednesday Homecoming events.
cards.source_title: Rowan University Homecoming Schedule of Events
cards.access_notes: Consult the current official schedule for location, time, team eligibility and weather-related updates.

cards.title: Lip Sync Competition
cards.subtitle: Thursday Homecoming staple
cards.notes: Look for the official Thursday Homecoming details if you want to perform or watch; requirements can change with each program year.
cards.short_summary: A named Homecoming staple held during the week’s Thursday events.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s official Homecoming schedule describes the Lip Sync Competition as a Homecoming staple held on Thursday.
cards.source_title: Rowan University Homecoming Schedule of Events
cards.access_notes: The official overview places the competition on Thursday; verify current event details through Homecoming.

cards.title: Haunted Student Center
cards.subtitle: Pre-Halloween community trick-or-treat event
cards.notes: Watch Student Center programming for the annual date, then attend with the event’s family-focused costume and entry guidance.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding Rowan Halloween tradition designed for children and the local community.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan describes the Haunted Student Center as a longstanding tradition that brings children from Rowan and the local community to a safe trick-or-treating setting.
cards.access_notes: Rowan says it is traditionally held on the last Friday before Halloween; confirm the current program before traveling.

cards.title: Lil' Sibs Weekend
cards.subtitle: Campus visit weekend for students’ siblings
cards.notes: Invite an eligible sibling and consult the current weekend schedule for age-specific activities, check-in details and any needed registration.
cards.short_summary: A weekend that lets Rowan students introduce younger siblings to campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan says Lil' Sibs Weekend lets students bring siblings ages 5–18 to campus for activities that experience college life.
cards.access_notes: Eligibility and event lineup can vary; Rowan identifies the intended sibling age range as 5–18.

cards.title: Cram Jam
cards.subtitle: End-of-semester overnight study event
cards.notes: Use the event as a structured finals-eve study session; check the Student Center calendar for the semester’s confirmed overnight details.
cards.short_summary: An annual late-night study tradition held immediately before finals.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan describes Cram Jam as an annual end-of-semester event with a 10 p.m.–6 a.m. quiet study space, snacks and activities before finals.
cards.access_notes: The official signature-events page lists Cram Jam from 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m.; verify the current semester’s date and access rules.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Rowan University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first pass through campus resources, creative spaces, local history and recurring ways to get involved.

cards.title: Start with the Information Desk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Pick up a campus map, ask about shuttle schedules and scan current event information before choosing the rest of your weekend route.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for directions, campus resources and event pointers.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s Information Desk provides campus maps, bus/shuttle schedules, event information and Glassboro community information.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of the Chamberlain Student Center.

cards.title: Take a daylight campus walk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Rowan University Arboretum
cards.notes: Use the outdoor loop to get oriented between campus buildings, then pause to notice the plantings and landscape that make up the arboretum.
cards.short_summary: A daylight walk that doubles as an introduction to campus landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan describes its arboretum as connecting people, plants and place through hands-on learning and environmental stewardship.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus destination; follow posted campus access guidance.

cards.entity_name: Rowan University Museum of Contemporary Art at 301 High Street
cards.title: See contemporary art downtown
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · 301 High Street West
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition online, then make time for a slow gallery visit and a look at the work’s labels before heading back toward campus.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission art stop in Rowan’s downtown gallery location.
cards.evidence_claim: RUMOCA at 301 High Street presents contemporary-art exhibitions; Rowan says its museum programming is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Rowan University Museum of Contemporary Art
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Tuesday–Friday and Saturday visiting hours; confirm the current exhibition schedule before going.

cards.title: Read the campus history at Hollybush
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Historic south edge of campus
cards.notes: View the historic exterior and, when a public tour or official function permits, look for the Summit artifacts that connect the mansion to 1967.
cards.short_summary: A landmark tied to the Glassboro Summit and Rowan’s earliest campus history.
cards.evidence_claim: Hollybush was the site of the 1967 Johnson–Kosygin Summit and now contains Summit artifacts for special University events.
cards.source_title: The Summit History | Hollybush | Rowan University
cards.access_notes: The mansion serves as a special-events venue; interior access depends on scheduled tours or events.

cards.title: Try the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Student Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring your Rowan ID, choose a comfortable activity and use the facility map to find the gym, track, pool or fitness areas that fit your plans.
cards.short_summary: A broad indoor recreation stop with fitness, court and aquatics spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rec Center includes a three-court gym, indoor track, 25-yard pool, racquetball courts, fitness areas and locker facilities.
cards.access_notes: Rowan says students carrying three or more credits have membership through the student activities fee; check current facility hours.

cards.title: Look for an intramural game
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Campus Recreation
cards.notes: Review the current intramural offerings, then join an activity at your comfort level or attend with a friend to learn how registration works.
cards.short_summary: A structured way to sample individual, dual or team recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan intramural sports offer individual, dual and team recreational activities for students of all ability levels.
cards.access_notes: Offerings and registration vary; consult Campus Recreation for the current schedule.

cards.title: Settle into Campbell Library
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Campbell Library
cards.notes: Find a seat, explore the library’s discovery tools and save one useful research or course-support contact for the first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: A focused campus stop for library help, collections and independent work.
cards.evidence_claim: Campbell Library supports the Glassboro campus with circulation, interlibrary loan, virtual help, welcome-desk support and research collections.
cards.source_title: Our Organization | Information Resources & Technology | Rowan University
cards.access_notes: Library access and service hours can vary by academic calendar period.

cards.title: Plan a planetarium show
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Science Hall
cards.notes: Check the current public-show calendar, choose a show that fits your weekend and arrive with enough time to handle ticketing before the program begins.
cards.short_summary: A public science-program stop built around immersive sky shows.
cards.evidence_claim: The Edelman Planetarium offers public shows, live stargazing and observatory open houses, with tickets available for public shows.
cards.access_notes: Public-show availability and ticket requirements vary; confirm the current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Check the home-game calendar
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Richard Wackar Stadium
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled Rowan athletics event, confirm its admission details and take in the stadium setting with fellow spectators if a game is on.
cards.short_summary: A home venue for Rowan athletics and scheduled campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan identifies Richard Wackar Stadium as the venue where Profs cheer for the home team.
cards.access_notes: Admission, seating and event times depend on the specific athletics schedule.

cards.title: Choose one way to get involved
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Chamberlain Student Center
cards.notes: Browse student-organization information, note one club or event that interests you and ask Student Center staff how to follow its next meeting or program.
cards.short_summary: A final planning stop for turning a weekend introduction into a campus connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Rowan’s Student Organization Services supports campus clubs and helps student organizations plan events through the Chamberlain Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Student Center staff can provide current organization and event information.
